reviewer.id: OpenAI Codex gpt-5.6-sol independent semantic reviewer with maintainer spot-check
reviewer.method: answer-by-answer semantic review against hidden source rubrics

status_meaning.answer_check_pass: the answer semantically satisfies the check
status_meaning.forbidden_assumption_pass: the answer does not violate the forbidden assumption
status_meaning.not_observable: the supplied model input did not make the criterion reviewable

answer_checks.description: Separate product content and policy from reusable runtime and tooling.
